courses.summary: This course will train you to become a composer with originality, heightened musical ability, and technical mastery. As digital media expands, so does the demand for talented composers in film, television, video games, and music. This specialisation helps you build a portfolio of work to land paid work and start your career as a composer. You will gain a theoretical and practical understanding of composition for today’s major media and will start building your own portfolio of work from day one. You will collaborate with students from different disciplines including performance and creative technology to create original songs, arrangements, orchestrations, soundtracks, and multimedia installations. The course can be completed in two years - 6 study periods or part-time equivalent. Delivery Mode: Face to Face with some online components.
courses.careers: Arranger/orchestrator, composer, conductor, live performer/instrumentalist, music director, music supervisor, music tutor, recording artist, songwriter, sound designer, ensemble director, ensemble musician, music librarian, music therapist, orchestral musician, private music tutor, professional instrumentalist, music teacher.
courses.practicalExperience: Collaboration projects with AIM students from other disciplines give you practical experience in writing, arranging, recording and performing.

courses.summary: This course blends research, theory, and philosophy to investigate the cultural history of music in its various forms, and how music is influenced by culture. Discover the practices, values, and ideas to make educated claims about how different people think and feel about the world. You will solidify a foundation in musical literacy, interact with materials that create music, examine how those elements are structured and notated in diverse genres, and develop your skills to identify musical structures by ear. courses.summary: This course is designed for artists seeking to perform at the highest level of music theatre. It prepares you for a professional career on stage, from leading roles to ensemble work and the creation of original productions. Through rigorous, practice-led training, you will develop advanced capabilities in singing, dance and acting, supported by personalised one-on-one tuition and guidance from experienced industry professionals.You will refine your technique, elevate your stagecraft, and cultivate the presence and discipline required of a professional performer. Alongside this, you will build a sustainable performance practice, grounded in a deep understanding of the psychology of performance. Graduating with substantial performance experience and a distinct artistic identity, you will be equipped to enter the industry as a versatile, confident and highly skilled music theatre artist. This course can be completed in 9 Study Periods (3 years) full-time. Delivery Mode: Face to Face with some online components.
